dict.string: snowfell-test-9 Distro testing build — TERMINAL LENS (merge tranche M4; merge architecture of record, minion-cli-high-sierra/files/MERGE-ARCHITECTURE-2026-11-14.md + the 2026-11-15 Piles addendum): a tenth navigation segment, Terminal (SFNavigationSectionTerminal appended after Piles; the View ▸ Terminal item carries NO ⌘ key — ⌘1–⌘9 and ⌘0 were all already assigned when Terminal landed), is the merged app's primary interface and its LAUNCH HOME: the window opens on the Terminal, prompt focused, the SDS-8 welcome presenting over it. The lens (TerminalViewController) links the ONE shared session core extracted in tranche M3 (MinionCore/, vendored byte-identical into this repo; bridge.h unchanged, SHA-256 73c78129f1bc591f069d8305b1aa7099dea532bf9d38dae46325963ca98ef105) and drives it exactly as the bundled CLI front-end does: every line enqueued first and drained head-first (FIFO, never superseded, never time-capped — the two defects of the retired hosted bridge this program exists to remove), DELTA snapshot-diff rendering, Stop = the core's interrupt flag, local commands at CLI parity (/help /clear /view honest stub — no hosted window exists /status /quit). Its status strip carries session state · snapshot version + freshness · core queue depth / staged count (two separate queues, never conflated). The `minion` CLI binary ships bundled at Contents/MacOS/minion, built in CI from the same core objects with the bundle's version stamp (CFBundleShortVersionString 0.1.0 — one version identity, architecture section C). HONEST SEAM STATE: the bridge's wire seam is UNCONFIRMED until the owner's T4 wire capture (tranche M6) fills it; with no session cookie supplied the bridge stops a send at the auth boundary, before any network traffic — nothing is sent; GUI Keychain cookie custody is M6's implementation and is NOT in this build; SNOWFELL_WRITEBACK_ENABLED still 0. Carries test-8 whole: snowfell-test-8 Distro testing build — PILES LENS (owner directive 2026-11-15: “instantiate pile organizational method in snowfell”; design record 13): a ninth navigation segment, Piles (SFNavigationSectionPiles appended after Updates, View ▸ Piles on ⌘0), carries the pile organizational method — every item lives in exactly one pile (enforced by UNIQUE(item_node_id) in the new local sf_piles / sf_pile_items tables in writeback.db, owned by the new PileStore on the DispatchStore pattern, sharing local_audit_log); items with no Status value land in the Inbox, one pile per board ordered by the board's own Status-vocabulary position then snapshot import order, reconcile adds only and is idempotent; the selected pile's top item is presented as the NEXT ACTION, with Move to Pile… (rows, card, Piles menu, ⌘M), Make Top, Clear Top (→ Done pile), New/Rename/Delete custom piles (delete rehomes to Inbox), and within-stack drag reorder (cross-pile drag not shipped); pile membership is a local organizational fact only — it is never written to the snapshot, never staged into the write-back queue, and the pile code has no GitHub path (SNOWFELL_WRITEBACK_ENABLED still 0). Carries test-7 whole: PER-BOARD GITHUB LINK (owner requirement 2026-11-14: “need application link to specific projects listed”): the Portfolio carries a GITHUB column whose per-row “Open in GitHub” opens that board's own GitHub Projects page, and the Board lens carries the same action for the board it shows — both via NSWorkspace in the owner's browser session, both using the board's stored sf_boards.url verbatim (the value has ridden in BoardSummary.url since SF-T2 and showed only as tooltip text; no URL is constructed by template; a board with no stored URL shows no button). Carries test-6 whole: SINGLE-WINDOW navigation (owner verdict 2026-11-14: the test-4 bar replicated on stacked per-lens windows was “haphazard and inconsistent”): one main window, all nine lenses (Portfolio · Board · Staged · Orchestration · Roadmap · Incidents · Storage · Updates · Piles) switch its content in place via the one NavigationBar; the filled segment always names the visible lens; no segment press creates or orders another window; Item Detail is an in-place drill-down in the same window (Board segment stays selected); Preferences and the Command Palette are the only auxiliary windows and carry no bar. This build also fixes the test-5 S4 crash on the Staged segment (EXC_BAD_ACCESS in -[AppDelegate showWriteBackQueue:]): the satellite Staged window's lifetime was tied to its closed state (default releasedWhenClosed) while AppDelegate held it as a strong property that was never nilled, so a Staged press after the window had been closed retained a freed object — proven by symbolication of the shipped test-5 binary (files/12). The satellite window no longer exists; the detail window met the same fate in the second crash (files/11 Addendum 2), so Item Detail is a drill-down in the one window too, and every remaining auxiliary window is created releasedWhenClosed = NO. Carries everything test-5 shipped: the Portfolio Updated column on sf_boards.gh_updated_at (bundled registry snapshot v10-0058, SHA-256 3af8e8a8551544931d39cff1899bf7c67a907cb8c510f15cafcf6b3ed37e3dd1), glanceable freshness (Updates ● badge + Portfolio freshness line), the M-09 storage-service bind clamp, decluttered staging language, SF-T12 storage, board-state derivation. CI-compiled from Academy source (AutomatedTechnologies/snowfell); audit + SDS-10 conformance attested by the build line on the shipped artifact 2026-11-12 (Distro files/08 rule; SDS-10 §10.5). Runtime verification is the owner's, at the Air sitting — install from the Distro listing.
